scope: Historical experiment dispositions, not recommendations to resume them. All unfinished Pro work stopped at user request.

historicalDispositions.interpretation: None of the three arms meets the predeclared development eligibility rule. Further work must investigate a substantive new mechanism, with independent correctness, speed and fresh strength validation before promotion.

relativeHistory.policy: Canonical Pro only; completed internal quiet-child visits add depth squared to trials and, on final-score beta cutoff, successes; cache floor(8191*successes/trials). Coupled halving at 2^30 and Pro-only lazy/reset storage.
relativeHistory.note: The exact recipe was restored and passed correctness, but failed the warm speed gate: Pro mean latency was about 0.88% higher for fixed work and 0.98% higher through the public API. Cold tests and games were not run. This is a workload-specific speed rejection, not a playing-strength result; disposable test artifacts were removed.

warmTest.criterion: Eight blocks; median and one-sided 95% geometric-mean upper ratio must both be <= 1; no exclusions or epsilon.
